Olga / team — reviewed Medora's redline and the SCC notes. Quick summary of positions and recommended language:

1) Sovereign data / EU residency:
- We cannot guarantee absolute physical-only residency for all telemetry/operational metadata across all product tiers without a Dedicated/Private deployment.
- Acceptable commercial compromise: commit to processing EU personal data only in EU regions for the duration of the agreement and use contractual controls + technical routing. Proposed clause: "For Customer accounts designated as EU accounts, Redwood will process EU personal data in EU-based data centers and will not transfer such personal data outside the European Economic Area except as required by law or with Customer's prior written consent."
- This keeps hosted customers on standard infra but gives a contractual commitment. If customer needs on-prem or VPC-only residency, that's a Dedicated/Private upsell.

2) Breach notification timeline:
- We can accept a 72-hour initial notification for incidents that materially affect personal data confidentiality/integrity. We will include reasonable exceptions for encrypted third-party breaches and active legal restrictions. Suggested text: "Redwood will notify Customer without undue delay and, where feasible, within seventy-two (72) hours after becoming aware of a Security Incident affecting Customer Personal Data."

3) HIPAA scope:
- If Customer will act as a Covered Entity and designate PHI processing, we require an executed BAA. Recommend adding a HIPAA addendum to the DPA as an exhibit — we have a template; Delivery lead needs to review for pilot constraints.

Next steps: attached is our redline (Redwood_DPA_response_redline.docx) with tracked changes and commentary. If you approve, we'll send the proposed redline to Medora and propose DocuSign routing: signature order = Medora Legal -> Olga (Sales) -> Marissa (Legal) -> Karthik (Ops signoff for Dedicated) if ops involvement required.

If Medora insists on physical isolated EU-only guarantee as a contract term, escalate to leadership (this is an exception to hosted policy).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
